routines.title: easy run warm-up
routines.why: a few dynamic moves get you moving freely. the first mile at a very easy pace does the rest.

exercises.name: brisk walk or very easy jog
exercises.how: start slower than your easy pace. no stopping to stretch first.

exercises.name: leg swings, front to back
exercises.how: hold a wall or post. relaxed swing, let the range grow each rep.

exercises.name: leg swings, side to side
exercises.how: face the wall, swing across your body and out.

exercises.name: walking lunge with reach
exercises.how: long step, back knee toward the ground, arms overhead. stand tall.

exercises.name: first mile easy
exercises.how: let the pace come to you. the app's easy zone is the ceiling, not the target.

routines.title: workout warm-up
routines.when: before road workouts, track sessions and time trials
routines.why: fast running needs warm muscles and a primed stride. a jog, dynamic moves, drills and strides beat static stretching before hard efforts.

exercises.name: easy jog
exercises.how: conversational. the last couple of minutes a little quicker.

exercises.name: leg swings, front and side
exercises.how: same as the easy warm-up.

exercises.name: lunge matrix
exercises.how: forward lunge, lunge with twist, side lunge, back lunge with reach, rotational lunge. smooth, not deep.

exercises.name: a-skip
exercises.how: skip with a high knee, foot lands under your hip. quick, light contacts.

exercises.name: b-skip
exercises.how: like an a-skip, then extend the leg and paw it back under you.

exercises.name: high knees
exercises.how: fast feet, tall posture, arms driving.

exercises.name: butt kicks
exercises.how: heel comes up under the hip, not out behind you.

exercises.name: carioca
exercises.how: sideways grapevine, hips rotating, light on your feet.

exercises.name: strides
exercises.how: build from jog to about mile pace over the first half, hold, then ease off. relaxed, not a sprint. walk back to recover.

exercises.name: before a time trial
exercises.how: finish the warm-up 5-10 min before the start. stay moving and warm until then.

routines.title: cool-down
routines.when: after workouts, track sessions and time trials. optional after easy runs.
routines.why: an easy jog brings you down gradually and adds easy miles. research shows it does little for next-day soreness or injury, so skip it when short on time.

exercises.name: easy jog or walk
exercises.how: slower than easy pace. walk if your legs are cooked.

exercises.name: calf stretch, straight knee
exercises.how: hands on a wall, back leg straight, heel down.

exercises.name: soleus stretch, bent knee
exercises.how: same position, bend the back knee until you feel it low in the calf.

exercises.name: kneeling hip flexor stretch
exercises.how: half kneel, squeeze the glute of the down leg, shift forward slightly.

exercises.name: hamstring stretch
exercises.how: heel on a low step, hinge from the hips with a flat back.

exercises.name: figure-4 glute stretch
exercises.how: on your back, ankle over the opposite knee, pull the thigh in.

routines.title: runner strength
routines.when: 2x a week, after an easy run or on a non-running day. not the day before a workout or time trial.
routines.why: heavy, slow strength work makes running more economical, and combining it with plyometrics later works best. add weight (dumbbells or a loaded backpack) once 3 sets feel easy. your weekly lift counts as one session if it hits legs heavy.

exercises.name: single-leg calf raise, straight knee
exercises.how: on a step, all the way up, 3 s down. hold something for balance only.

exercises.name: bent-knee calf raise (soleus)
exercises.how: knee bent about 30 degrees the whole time. the soleus takes a big share of the load every stride.

exercises.name: rear-foot elevated split squat
exercises.how: back foot on a bench, front knee tracks over toes, go deep and controlled.

exercises.name: single-leg romanian deadlift
exercises.how: hinge on one leg, flat back, weight in the opposite hand.

exercises.name: single-leg glute bridge
exercises.how: drive through the heel, hips level, 2 s hold at the top.

exercises.name: side plank
exercises.how: straight line from head to feet, hips high.

exercises.name: dead bug
exercises.how: lower back stays pressed to the floor while opposite arm and leg reach out.

routines.title: hip routine (myrtl)
routines.when: 2-3x a week, right after a run
routines.why: short hip circuit used by many coaches to keep the hips strong and mobile. no equipment.

exercises.name: myrtl routine
exercises.how: clamshells, side leg raises, fire hydrants, hip circles, donkey kicks and more, about 10 reps each.

routines.title: foot and big toe
routines.when: 3x a week, any time. good while watching tv.
routines.why: strong feet help absorb faster running. with your sesamoid history, keep load gradual and stop anything that hurts under the big toe joint.

exercises.name: toe yoga
exercises.how: lift only the big toe while the others stay down, then the reverse.

exercises.name: short foot
exercises.how: shorten the foot by lifting the arch, toes stay relaxed and flat.

exercises.name: towel scrunch
exercises.how: pull a towel toward you with your toes, seated.

exercises.name: single-leg balance
exercises.how: barefoot on a flat floor. eyes closed once it's easy.

routines.title: plyometrics (later)
routines.when: add from phase 2, 1-2x a week after 6+ weeks of strength with no foot pain. on grass or a track, in shoes.
routines.why: springy, low-amplitude jumps train stiffness and elastic return. combined with heavy strength it gives the biggest gains. they load the forefoot, so build slowly.

exercises.name: pogo hops
exercises.how: two feet, small fast bounces off the ankles, knees nearly straight.

exercises.name: skips for height
exercises.how: power skip, drive the knee and arm up.

exercises.name: bounding
exercises.how: exaggerated running strides, long time in the air, land under the hip.

exercises.name: single-leg hops
exercises.how: only once the others feel easy. stop if anything hurts under the big toe.
